integrity: All central assertions are supported by an analytical calculation; finite arithmetic and orbit checks are supplements, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Local discrete-time predator-prey theorem at exact invasion threshold beta*gamma*(lambda-1)=1; fixed lambda>1, 0<gamma<1. No global basin, stochastic-population, or large-parameter coexistence claim. Equivalent unindexed work remains a priority risk.
title: Cubic slowing at the invasion threshold of a cooperative-hunting refuge map
